reception: External take-up of the commensal approach is limited. LaminarIR, with its compile-time queues for structured streams, measures its performance against StreamJIT, and that is the one sustained engagement in the record. The other citations are list placements: RaftLib and Streams a la carte name StreamJIT among stream programming systems, and an application of OpenTuner to GPU compiler parameters lists it among systems that delegate tuning decisions to OpenTuner. The record is small enough that reception reads as recognition among stream-language designers rather than adoption of commensal compilation elsewhere.
